excerpt.zh: [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]会凝视虚境，以期获得对[Target.GetName]的内部运作具有指导意义的见解。
excerpt.en: The [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] will peer into the Shroud in hopes of gaining insight into the inner workings of the [Target.GetName].

sections.zh: 我们对虚境的掌控加速了这个进程，允许我们协助[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]的任务。
sections.en: Our mastery of the Shroud hastens the process and allows us to assist the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] with their task.
